spans.s: (derivation unknown) = शिफा (which is the more usual form; see below), L.
a fibrous or flexible root (used for making whips &c.), Mn. ix, 230
a lash or stroke with a whip or rod, ib. viii, 369
N. of a river, RV. (L. also ‘a branch; a river; a mother; a tuft of hair on the crown of the head; the root of a water-lily; spikenard; turmeric; a sort of dill or fennel’).
शिफा—कन्द m. n. the root of a water-lily, L.
शिफा—धर m. ‘possessing fibres’, a branch, L.
शिफा—रुह m. ‘growing from fibres which descend to the ground’, the Banyan tree, L.
the root of a water-lily, L.
(also, written शेफाली, or शेफालिका) the plant Nyctanthes Tristis, L.
